bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 172, Number 89 (Tuesday, May 26, 2026)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. SHERMAN:
H.R. 9040.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I Section 8 of the US Constitution providing
Congress with the power to regulate commerce.
[Page H3735]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, and Financial Services, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
